author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I asked GPT, Claude, Gemini, Muse explain to me how square root is implemented in software and hardware.

I like GPT's answer the best, then Gemini, then Claude in term of easy to understand. Honestly, I am happy to take any one of those three. Definitely better than reading any math textbook or Wikipedia.

Muse totally failed, I can't understand a thing it says. I feel Facebook RL Muse to be something different, it is good at doing things for you, but they seems to skip the era when LLM is a good chat companion.

Why do I need to know how square root is calculated? I am debugging 100% AI generated Intel 4004 and Busicom 141-PF. The best frontier models still can't write the RTL of a 55 years old calculator correctly all by itself.

Yeap. I don't let the AI cheat by peeking at the emulator. It has to recreate the whole thing from data sheet and the user manual alone.
